typography.strategy: The 'Editorial Future' pairing. 'Outfit' provides a modern, geometric, and friendly aesthetic suitable for an educational platform. 'Manrope' offers clean, highly readable body text, crucial for bilingual support (Russian/English text expansion). Use tracking-tight for H1/H2.

colors.description: Optimistic, light, tactile pastels paired with hard charcoal borders to avoid looking childish and to create a structured 'sandbox' feel. Ideal for a safe, engaging educational environment.

visual_enhancers.surface_strategy: Neo-Brutalist Tactile. Cards and interactive elements MUST have flat solid backgrounds (White, or Pastel), 2px border (#0F172A), and a solid hard drop shadow (e.g., shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(15,23,42,1)]).
visual_enhancers.hover_effects: On hover, elements translate to simulate pressing down: translate-x-[2px] translate-y-[2px] shadow-[2px_2px_0px_0px_rgba(15,23,42,1)]. Active state: translate-x-[4px] translate-y-[4px] shadow-none.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid glassmorphism for this Neo-brutalist theme. The header MUST use a solid background (bg-white or bg-slate-50) with a hard bottom border (border-b-2 border-slate-900).

components.card: Solid white background, 2px border-slate-900, hard shadow. Contains: Thumbnail, Title, Subject/Grade badges, Author info, Like/Favorite counts. Generous internal padding (p-4 or p-6).
components.badges: Pill-shaped (rounded-full), pastel backgrounds with 1px dark border and text-xs font-bold text-slate-900.
components.buttons: Primary CTA: Sunny Yellow (bg-yellow-300), 2px dark border, hard shadow, rounded-md. Secondary: White background, 2px dark border.
components.iframe_player: Wrap the sandboxed iframe in a container resembling a retro OS window or browser frame. Top bar with 3 decorative dots (red, yellow, green) to visually signify a 'sandbox'.
components.tabs: Override Shadcn tabs to have a Neo-brutalist look: hard borders on the active tab, solid colors instead of subtle grays.
components.inputs: Shadcn inputs customized with border-2 border-slate-900, rounded-md. focus:ring-2 focus:ring-sky-300 focus:outline-none.

grids.feed_grid: grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 2xl:grid-cols-5. 10 items per page fits well in various grid configurations. Gap should be gap-6 or gap-8.
grids.publish_grid: grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 with gap-8 for the side-by-side publish form and live preview.

layouts.general: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-6, p-8, p-12. Containers with borders MUST have internal padding to prevent text collision.
layouts.publish_form: Left side: Form controls (metadata, HTML code editor). Right side: Sticky live iframe preview (h-[80vh]) to see changes instantly.
layouts.assignment_view: Top metadata header (Title, Author, Stats). Full-width or large container (aspect-video) for the sandboxed iframe player. Action buttons (Like, Favorite, Report) below the iframe.
layouts.admin_dashboard: High Density Grid (MODE B). Use a table with sticky headers for moderation (approving/rejecting assignments, viewing reports). Tight spacing in the table, but generous on the page.

motion.interactions: Crisp, tactile micro-interactions. 'Press down' effect on buttons and cards. Fast transitions (duration-150 ease-out).
motion.forbidden: No universal 'transition: all'. Exclude transforms from universal transitions to prevent breaking the press-down effect.

accessibility.contrast: High contrast guaranteed by deep slate text (#0F172A) and borders on pastel/light backgrounds.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements MUST have prominent focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-slate-900).
accessibility.bilingual: UI MUST accommodate varying text lengths (Russian text is typically 20-30% longer than English). Avoid fixed-width containers or heights for text elements. Use flex and wrap appropriately.

media.strategy: Use abstract or subject-specific images for assignment thumbnails if the user hasn't provided one. Icons should be clear and friendly.

3d_libraries.strategy: Not required for the core UI, as the primary interactive content is hosted inside user-generated HTML iframes. Keep the outer platform lightweight.

math_placeholder.description: Blackboard with math equations, used as a placeholder cover for Math assignments.

physics_placeholder.description: Electronic circuit boards, used as a placeholder cover for Physics assignments.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use `@phosphor-icons/react` for UI icons.
Use `Outfit` for all headings and `Manrope` for body text. Do not use Inter for headings.
Implement a 'Neo-Brutalist' aesthetic: 2px solid dark borders (#0F172A) and solid drop shadows for cards, buttons, and form inputs.
Ensure the header has a solid background with a 2px bottom border, NOT fully transparent.
For the Assignment View page, style the iframe container to look like a sandbox/window (e.g., adding a fake OS window title bar).
Add 'data-testid' attributes to all interactive elements and key information.
Handle bilingual text (RU/EN) gracefully by using flexible layouts and generous padding. Provide a clear language toggle in the header.
The iframe MUST have the 'sandbox' attribute enabled for security (e.g., sandbox='allow-scripts allow-same-origin').
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic centered layouts and simplistic gradients. Create depth through layered design elements (hard shadows in this case). Do not use 'transition: all'. Do not center align the app container. Use modern button styles (Neo-Brutalist in this case). Add micro-animations (press down effects). Never use AI assistant emoji characters for icons. Use sonner for toasts. Prioritize building robust, visually distinct custom components over default Shadcn styles.
